durability: The task owns the six-part observation frontier before implementation. Prototype, prospective plan, harness, independent auditor and exact result/TAP/guard-log recovery copies are tracked. The prior ignored runtime result is restored byte-exactly. Complete historical foundation nodes and the completed maintenance checklist are retained through authenticated exact Git version objects; no active node is compacted.
falsification: Changed birth fields and swapped birth order derive different keys. Malformed fields, types, paths, duplicate/noncanonical JSON, excess sizes and cross-format substitutions reject. Locally removing field closure, key derivation or birth validation admits independently invalid bytes. Independent result mutations must all reject.
limits: The closed observation format retains the canonical C/executable pair. Wrapper/runtime-reference snapshots are separately owned observation custody, not extra fields in this global retention record.
Canonical evidence path spelling and native birth fields are structural data, not current filesystem containment or ownership, actual PID/API admission, liveness or loaded-image attestation.

rederive: Independent Python code constructs content keys from the original inert bytes, derives canonical observation keys from the ordered evidence-path/observer/target array, validates exact closed types/paths/identities and reconstructs the complete prospective plan. It requires every planned vector, rejection and mutant in the result and checks complete TAP numbering; the unchanged runtime codec is independently revalidated.
